name: Paid Order — Customer Confirmation & Admin Alert (DEV)

parameters.jsCode: const r = $input.first().json; const b = r.body; const allowed = ['AUTHENTICATION_FAILED','ALVERON_API_FAILURE','RATE_LIMITED','VALIDATION_FAILED','CUSTOMER_EMAIL_MISSING','NOTIFICATION_NOT_SENT','DELIVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED','LEDGER_FAILURE','INTERNAL_ERROR']; if (r.statusCode !== 200 || !b || b.status !== 'completed' || b.failed !== 0) { const reasons = Array.isArray(b?.results) ? b.results.map(x => x.reason) : [b?.code]; const safe = [...new Set(reasons.filter(x => allowed.includes(x)))]; throw new Error('GATEWAY_RUN_FAILED:' + (safe.join(',') || 'GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE')); } if (typeof b.runId !== 'string' || !Number.isInteger(b.processed)) throw new Error('GATEWAY_RUN_FAILED:VALIDATION_FAILED'); return [{json:{runId:b.runId,status:b.status,processed:b.processed,skipped:b.skipped,failed:b.failed}}];
